name: the work remade in other media, often before the close
what_it_changes: Within F11, members remake the canvas work elsewhere (fan art, games, physical copies, a quoted text), and this often begins while the original is still live.
why: Cut rule R3: a level-3 child of F11's key, held by 5 or more of its members, whose lines (read in _analysis/d4a02_keys/add-step_P13_T4-028.txt) state a narrower change than F11's. 'Design reuse begins during live construction and continues in later fan making' (lovelive); 'Participants recruit creative work and turn canvas features into proposed game characters, locations, plots and fanart' (touhou). These are the labelers' how sentences.
